bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
db="$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=deploy --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=postgres --format '{{.Names}}' | head -1)"
test -n "$db"
{ echo PR47_PROFILE_INSERT_SCHEMA
docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT column_name||':'||data_type||':'||is_nullable||':'||COALESCE(column_default,'') FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='posting_topics' ORDER BY ordinal_position;"
echo AREA_DB_EXISTING
docker exec "$db" psql -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT topic_id,board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,title,verified_by,enabled FROM posting_topics WHERE board_key='area_bbs' LIMIT 20;"
} | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
